Final for Publication

File No. 22971-T1

17-13-0303-C(1) Substitute Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1313-15 W. Ancona St., Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: | RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 4,323.6 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to redevelop the subject property with three (3)
new single-family residences. The proposed buildings will all be three-
stories in height and will feature an attached garage with two (2) off-street
parking spaces within the basement of each building. The proposed single-
family homes will measure approximately 37 ft.-10 in. in height. Pursuant
to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation
and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the
Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback for each single-family
residence from the required 16.8 ft. to 2 ft., reduce the front setback from
the required 7.2 ft. to zero, reduce the rear yard open space from the required
93.6 sq. ft. to zero, reduce the combined side setback from the required 4.8
ft. to 4 ft.-2 inches (east side setback at 3 ft.; west side setback at 14 in.),
and is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the code, per the attached

plans.
(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 2,443 each home (1.7)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 1,441.2 square feet per D.U.
G single-family residences)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 6 parking spaces total
(2 parking spaces for each residence)

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: zero feet (proposed)
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 14 inches (proposed)
East Side: 3 feet (proposed)
c. Rear Setback: 2 feet (proposed)

*The Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback for each single-family
residence from the required 16.8 ft. to 2 ft., reduce the front setback from the
required 7.2 ft. to zero, reduce the combined side setback from the required 4.8 ft.
to 4 ft.- 2 inches (east side setback at 3 ft.; west side setback at 14 in.).

(E) — Building Height: 37 feet-10 inches (proposed)
